annotations.text: This Software Bill-of-Materials (SBOM) document was created on Wednesday, June 10, 2026 with cdxgen. The data was captured during the build lifecycle phase. The document describes an application named 'github.com/ddddddO/gtree'. The application also has 3 child modules/components. The package type in this SBOM is golang with 7 purl namespaces described under components. The components were identified from 4 source files.
